prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
System: Regional Dispatch Center (Juniper), primary EMS dispatch: intake, triage, dispatch, coverage, readiness, audit, change/release control, corrective actions. Zones have primary/alternate routes to Emergency Department and Riverside Trauma Center. Juniper creates incident record, produces Unit Staging Change Card, records authorization/selection reasons, alternative routes and capability restrictions (rationale/scope/duration); retains audit evidence under access/retention controls; reviews service measures vs thresholds (demand, coverage, delay, comms, data quality). Modes: Surge (Juniper declares); Mutual aid; Degraded-radio (emergency traffic priority; voice fails→approved data channel, record attempt times; after restore reconcile vs timestamps, keep discrepancies). Handover: Shift Commander keeps authority until successor acknowledges; outgoing records incidents/failures/channels/pending decisions; incoming verifies before control. Actors: Call Taker Mara (Larkspur): location first; produces Caller Location Correction Slip; keeps caller connected; receives Bedside Arrival Receipt. Triage Supervisor (Copperfield): priority; Pediatric Acuity Note; approves overrides; reviews Duplicate Incident Audit Memo and acuity/escalation-risk cases. Regional Medical Director: clinical advice; approves clinical guidance changes; reviews significant events with Shift Commander. Dispatcher recommends units. Shift Commander (Sundial): operational authority; sends Mutual Aid Release Form; receives Coverage Gap Bulletin; may restrict capability for unacceptable defect risk. Radio Coordinator (Mistral): Regional Radio Network (checked after maintenance/config before use); sends Coverage Gap Bulletin; uses change card, South Access Lane Notice. Paramedic Crew: acknowledges/repeats. Hospital Liaison Desk (Kestrel): confirms capacity; produces Bedside Arrival Receipt; contributes observations, protects info. Fleet Maintenance Cell (Bluejay): Battery Swap Voucher; uses Mutual Aid Release Form; preventive scheduling; maintenance records (asset ID, work, parts, return-to-service). Data Quality Officer (Pebble): sends audit memo; checks timestamps; no priority changes. Systems: CAD Console (latest confirmed status; scenario-tested before change authorized); Ambulance Coordination Platform (mutual aid, queues updates, flags reconciliation; changes impact-assessed; monitored availability/response/integrity/interfaces); Ambulance Unit 417; North/South Gate Status Boards; North Approach Queue Snapshot. Reqs: audit findings list records/criteria/limitations; findings assigned owner/due date/closure verification; release records owner/test evidence/limitations/rollback; corrective actions verified for effectiveness; recurring issues get

New part:
S247: The Regional Dispatch Center provides a periodic summary of assurance activities, open risks, and improvement progress to regional oversight.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
